utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-01-42/1-A, the Prosecutor versus Miodrag Jokic. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. The appearances, please, first for the appellant.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to my learned friends from the Prosecution. My name is Zarko Nikolic. To my right is Ms. Jelena Nikolic, and Mr. Eugene O'Sullivan. We represent the defence for the appellant today. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: I'm sorry, could you repeat, please, because I had a problem with the --

utterances.speaker: MR. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you, Mr. Nikolic. The appellant, could you please inform the Court if you can hear and understand the proceedings. THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I can hear and understand the proceedings. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. Now the appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to my learned colleagues. Appearing for the Prosecution is Norman Farrell and with me is Ms. Marie-Ursula Kind and Ms. Susan Grogan. Thank you. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. I have an announcement to make. One of our colleagues, Judge Schomburg, is indisposed and for this reason we will not be able to proceed with the hearing today and we will have to adjourn the hearing. We will reschedule and inform at a later date in which the hearing will continue. Thank you.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 9.45 a.m.,
